purpose: Map library neuron populations onto real MaleCNS v1.0 cells and measure the real superclass connectivity backbone, so a declared pathway can be falsified. Presence and non-contradiction only; the declared microcircuit and connection FORM remain literature-derived.

anchored_type_matrix.format: rows[i] = `<col>:<synapses>:<edges>` entries for row type index i, columns ascending; empty string = no measured outgoing synapses

kenyon_cell.note: Kenyon cells: the KCg / KCab / KCa'b' clans, the intrinsic MB cells.

mushroom_body_dan.note: Dopaminergic neurons of the MB: the PAM / PPL / PPM clans.

mushroom_body_apl.note: The single giant GABAergic MB feedback neuron (APL).

antennal_lobe_pn.note: Antennal-lobe projection neurons: adPN / lPN / lvPN / uPN classes.

antennal_lobe_ln.note: Antennal-lobe local neurons, narrowly matched on the unambiguous LNO / GLNO / LN-number classes. Deliberately excludes LNd (a clock group, not an AL LN), so this is a LOWER BOUND on the AL local-neuron population, not the whole class.

central_complex_eb.note: Ellipsoid-body columnar cells (EPG) plus the EL/PEG tangential set.

central_complex_pb.note: Protocerebral-bridge columnar cells: PEN_a/PEN_b and the IB* columnar types.

central_complex_fb.note: Fan-shaped-body columnar cells: PFN/PFNa/PFNd and the FS/FC sets.

central_complex_noduli.note: Noduli cells (Nod1-5) -- the smallest CX neuropil.
central_complex_noduli.caveat: The dataset files Nod1-5 under `visual_projection`, not cb_intrinsic, which is unexpected for CX noduli cells. The match is therefore a NAME match with a possibly wrong dataset label; treat as low confidence.

central_complex_ring.note: Ring neurons of the ellipsoid body: Delta / vDelta / hDelta and the ER series.

clock_neuron_slnv.note: Small ventral lateral clock neurons -- the master pacemaker subset.

descending_neuron.note: Descending neurons (DNg / DNp / DNge / DNpe / DNx) carrying brain output to the VNC. The superclass filter excludes the clock DN1/DN2/DN3 cells and the DNES endocrine cells that share the name prefix.

ol_photoreceptor_r1r6.note: Outer photoreceptors R1-R6: the dataset types the whole outer channel as one class. The exact-match regex plus ol_sensory excludes any other R-prefixed type.

ol_photoreceptor_r7r8.note: Inner photoreceptors R7/R8 (R7y/R7p/R8y/R8_unclear and friends): the colour channel that bypasses the lamina and targets the medulla.

ol_lamina_monopolar.note: Lamina monopolar cells L1-L5, exact matches only so that LC12/LT51/LAL094 style names can never be swallowed.

ol_medulla_intrinsic.note: Medulla columnar cells: Tm1-20, TmY series and the Mi series - the early-vision compute layer.

ol_motion_detector_t45.note: T4a-d / T5a-d: the eight direction-selective elementary motion detector classes, one per lobula-plate layer and direction.

ol_lptc.note: Lobula-plate tangential cells (HSN/HSE/HSS/HST, VS/VST, CH, FD): the wide-field optic-flow integrators. Few but famous.

ol_lpi.note: Lobula-plate intrinsic cells LPi: GABAergic inter-columnar links behind directional opponency.

ol_visual_lc.note: Lobula columnar (LC) visual projection neurons: feature- and target-selective detectors with named glomerular targets.

escape_giant_fiber.note: The giant fiber: MaleCNS type DNp01, the descending jump-escape command neuron (instances carry the (GF) annotation).

escape_vnc_gfc.note: Giant-fiber-connected interneurons GFC1-4 in the ventral nerve cord.

escape_psi.note: The peripheral synapsing interneuron (PSI), relay of the DLM escape branch.

escape_jump_motor.note: Jump/flight-power motor neurons: TTMn (tergotrochanteral jump), DLMn and STTMm (dorsal longitudinal / steering flight power).

courtship_pc1.note: The pC1/P1 courtship decision cluster: 49 MaleCNS types. The superclass filter keeps the match inside the brain.

courtship_asp.note: Male-specific aggression neurons: the aSP10 subtypes.

courtship_pip.note: pIP1/pIP10: courtship descending neurons carrying the decision to the VNC.

song_vnc_int.note: VNC song-network interneurons: the vMS11/vMS12 and vPR song pattern generator classes.

song_vpo.note: Ventral protocerebrum song-pathway cells vpoEN/vpoIN: recurrent partners of pC1. Note they are BRAIN cells - do not retag them as VNC.

auditory_ammc.note: Antennal mechanosensory and motor centre (AMMC) neurons: the first brain relay of near-field sound, i.e. the courtship song.

lateral_horn_ln.note: Lateral horn neuron families (LHPV/LHLN/...): the innate-odour centre. Broad by design - the LH is typed by hundreds of families, all of them lateral horn cells.

antennal_orn.note: Olfactory receptor neurons typed per glomerular class (ORN_DA1, ORN_VA1d, ...). This resolves what the generic `olfactory_receptor` profile could not: the fly ORN classes ARE published in this release.
